description: We are students from Scholars' secondary school Egypt which take the best 96 students in Egypt we have skills in coding, web development, designing, presentations and gaming. We love participating in science competitions.
summary: Monitor ++ is a website that helps astronauts to keep tracking their health (mentally and physically) by some features like amount of lighting , movement and sleep tracker ,journal for digital writing ,hand-eye coordination, heart rate tracker, exercising tracker , air quality tracker and diseases diagnosing tool
details:
Our website have 8 features


1-Radiation tracker:
We provides a space radiation tracker that tracks the amount of space radiation and gives an alert for high percentages .


2-Journal:
We provide a journal that helps astrounauts write thier daily events that helps in improving mental health.


3-Light ,Movement and Sleeping tracker:
We made a tracker for lighting, movement and sleep which helps in improving mental and physical health.


4-Hand-eye coordination test:
We made hand-eye coordination test to test astronauts balance and test the effect of the gravity difference on astronauts.


5-Heart rate tracker:
We made heart rate tracker to track heart rate of astronauts in rest and excersicing.


6-Exercising tracker:
We made a tracker for excersicing that records excersicing minutes and your daily goals.


7-Air quality tracker:
We made an air quality tracker for tracking air quality and providing alerts for high air pollution percentages.


8-Diseases Diagnosing:
We made a simple Diseases Diagnoser that diagnoses diseases according to the symptomps.


it was designed to take direct inputs from outer sensors but as it is a prototype we made it user-input to test if it is working it is made by HTML,CSS and javascript.

so our project solves many problems

1-Space radiation:
We help solving space radiation problems by a tracker that tracks the amount of radiation and alerts astronauts of it’s percentages.

2-Mental health problems:
We slove this problem by the lighting,movement and sleep tracker , and the journal

3-Physical health:
We solve this problem by excersicing tracker, hand-eye coordination , heart rate tracker and diseases diagnoser

4-Air Quality:
We made an air quality tracker that tracks the air quality and give you regular alerts about the air quality
